outcome: Duration of first stage of induced labor (IOL)
Duration of second stage of IOL
Total time from IOL beginning to delivery
cohort: The study included 668 women with singleton, term pregnancies and cephalic presentation who underwent induced labor between June 2018 and December 2019, categorized by pre-pregnancy BMI (normal weight vs. obese) and parity.
finding: Obese multiparous women experienced longer first stages of induced labor but shorter second stages, while obese nulliparous women had a significantly longer total time from labor induction to delivery compared to normal-weight counterparts.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal deliveries, emergency cesarean section, and failed induced labor were similar between normal weight and obese groups.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from June 2018 to December 2019.
